feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Met Office names second storm to hit UK in 24 hours
articles.summary: The second named storm of the season is set to hit the UK on Saturday, the Met Office has said.

articles.title: Three more arrests over Nottingham police officer shooting
articles.summary: Three more people have been arrested over the shooting of a police officer in Nottingham city centre.

articles.title: Woman who died after crash had 'unrelated' injuries
articles.summary: A woman who died following a car crash in South Wales had sustained injuries that were not related to the incident, police have said.

articles.title: 'Millions' of exploitation attempts since security flaw affecting websites emerged
articles.summary: There have been "millions" of exploitation attempts since a "critical" security flaw affecting websites around the world emerged, according to a major tech company.

articles.title: 1800s law must be updated to protect 'backbone' of UK - MP
articles.summary: An inadequate law from the 19th century must be strengthened to deter saboteurs from attacking the UK's critical undersea cables and pipelines, a minister has said.

articles.title: Offenders who refuse to attend sentencing will face new penalties
articles.summary: Offenders, including killers, who refuse to attend sentence hearings could be confined to their cell for weeks or lose visiting privileges.

articles.title: Police given more time to question two men re-arrested in RAF Fairford investigation
articles.summary: Two men who were re-arrested as part of an investigation into a suspected terror plot near RAF Fairford can be held for up to seven days after police were given more time to question them.

articles.title: Scrap 'unfair' prescription charges in England, say pharmacies
articles.summary: Pharmacy leaders have called for prescription charges to be scrapped in England.

articles.title: Jailed former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson accused of rape inside Parliament - reports
articles.summary: Police are investigating former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson over an allegation that he raped a woman in the Houses of Parliament, the PA news agency reports.
